body:
The Geo widget use the raw Google Maps to render the map but the rest is rendered with Preact. The `ais-GeoSearch-tree` is required to mount the  Preact root element. We can't use a blank element because inside [the unmount function](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/ef731cc48c7640aac71e09db799b476ef2474f3b/src/widgets/geo-search/geo-search.js#L252-L254) we have to find this element to unmount the Preact tree with `unmountComponentAtNode`. Since we don't have support of `Fragments` in Preact we have the extra `div` above `ais-GeoSearch-control`. 

I don't think we have to update the specs it's an implementation detail of this widget. React does not have this extra element for example.
